{{- /* The browser chrome takes the page background, from the brand tokens (data/brand.json). */}} {{/* A page without a title breaks tab titles, sidebar rows, related links and landing cards, so it fails the build in the params.homeSlug section, the docs written today. Released versions are frozen rel/* branches (the versioned build publishes every one), and some predate this check: their untitled CodeMirror6_GenAI_Integration.md would fail every production build. There it only warns, and the tab falls back to the page's first "# " heading. */}} {{ $title := .Title }} {{ if and (not $title) (not .IsHome) }} {{ with findRESubmatch `(?m)^#\s+(.+?)\s*$` .RawContent 1 }}{{ $title = index (index . 0) 1 }}{{ end }} {{ $msg := "Page %q has an empty title — add `title` to its frontmatter (breaks tab titles, sidebar rows, related links, and landing cards)" }} {{ if eq .Section site.Params.homeSlug }}{{ errorf $msg .Path }}{{ else }}{{ warnf $msg .Path }}{{ end }} {{ end }} {{ $pageTitle := cond .IsHome .Site.Title $title }} {{ $description := .Params.description | default site.Params.description }} {{ if .IsHome }}{{ .Site.Title }}{{ else }}{{ $title }} | {{ .Site.Title }}{{ end }} {{ $canonical := partial "canonical-url.html" . }} {{/* llms.txt (https://llmstxt.org/): the index that covers this page, and the page's own Markdown copy when it has one (MARKDOWN output format; the API reference pages do). */}} {{ with site.Home.OutputFormats.Get "LLMS" }}{{ end }} {{ with .OutputFormats.Get "MARKDOWN" }}{{ end }} {{/* Social cards, the same set the GoodData Cloud docs emit (Docsy's opengraph and twitter_cards partials), so a shared link renders the same card from either site. og:url is the canonical URL, not .Permalink: an archived copy of a page then shares as the latest one, which is also where the canonical sends crawlers. The card image is a site param (params.seo.image) because this theme serves more than one site; without it the card is text-only. */}} {{- /* A site-relative image (static/og/…) becomes an absolute URL: crawlers need one. */ -}} {{ $seoImage := "" }}{{ with site.Params.seo.image }}{{ $seoImage = cond (hasPrefix . "http") . (absURL .) }}{{ end }} {{ with $seoImage }} {{ end }} {{ with $seoImage }}{{ end }} {{/* The same two icons as the GoodData Cloud docs (copied from www.gooddata.ai), shipped in the theme's static/ so the site serves its own /favicon.ico and /apple-touch-icon.png. */}} {{ with site.Params.search }}{{ with .customFieldVersion }}{{ end }}{{ end }} {{ $b := hugo.Data.brand.fonts }} {{ $fams := slice (printf "%s:wght@600;700" (replace $b.headingFamily " " "+")) (printf "%s:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700" (replace $b.bodyFamily " " "+")) }} {{ $fontsURL := printf "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=%s&display=swap" (delimit $fams "&family=") | safeURL }} {{ partial "css.html" . }}
